title: Rigorous Analysis of the Dynamic Cube Attack on Full Grain-128
summary: Large-scale experiments support the dynamic cube attack on full Grain-128, but its expected bias, guess ranking, and complexity still lack rigorous mathematical analysis.

formal_statement.body: Rigorously analyze the expected bias, guess ranking, and complexity of the dynamic cube attack on full Grain-128.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis of full Grain-128 using dynamic cube attacks and cube testers.
assumptions: Incorrect guesses behave as random functions when estimating the correct guess's rank.
parameters: Expected bias — probabilistic behavior of the attack requiring analysis
Guess ranking — position of the correct guess among candidate guesses
Attack complexity — computational work required by the attack
Cube dimensions 49 and 50 — dimensions used in the reported experimental summations
scope.unresolved_remainder: Derive a rigorous mathematical analysis of the expected bias, guess ranking, and complexity of the dynamic cube attack on full Grain-128.

citations.label: An Experimentally Verified Attack on Full Grain-128 Using Dedicated Reconfigurable Hardware

progress.summary: The paper treats mathematical analysis as difficult, verifying complexity through experiments over dozens of random keys and thousands of cube summations and estimating guess ranking with a random-function model. A rigorous derivation remains unresolved.
citation_labels: Itai Dinur et al., An Experimentally Verified Attack on Full Grain-128 Using Dedicated Reconfigurable Hardware
